scope_limits.accepted_candidate: Every accepted Certified/Result is sound for the exact graph, root and public model. There is no theorem that generic generate or plan accepts every input.
scope_limits.not_only_selected_edges: NodeValid quantifies every legal alternative and every positive receipt; execution subgraph and optimality proof graph are different counted objects.
scope_limits.raw_real_history: conditional_count_posterior handles real RawCausalPolicy action probabilities. Final native optimality compares the original belief-model RawCausalPolicy under SupportedAdmissible, not just compact-state policies.
scope_limits.joint_law: joint_observable_law is an arbitrary joint test, not a product of independently assumed marginals. tapeWeight_transfer itself quantifies adaptive Tables; raw randomized coverage has separate declared interfaces.
scope_limits.world_relation: Rel and StepRefinement are proof-side predicates. Concrete refinement and initial_relation are source-derived; no scheduler is given hidden world data or a sufficiency oracle.
scope_limits.payment: graph_native_payment does not require Good or optimality. Native prepayment applies on positive prior/source tapes and uses requested cap before the outcome, then actual record fee.
scope_limits.safe_defaults: controllerAction_mem and denote_feasible are global; no conditional world-law claim is made for impossible histories. Zero-normalizer prior and wallet clamp are total off-path definitions.
scope_limits.native_runtime: packedRun is executable. nativeRun is a noncomputable original-record semantic definition; nativeRun_eq/nativeRun_project connect it to original native execution and the computable packed interpreter.
scope_limits.node_bound: 24*(H+1)^4 bounds the complete actual accepted array. It is not a bound on rational bit length, total bytes, wall time, or a minimal-state theorem.
scope_limits.denotation: denote is used in proofs, absent from runtime generation, direct graph execution and serialization.
scope_limits.serialization: No Lean JSON decoder/roundtrip theorem was added. The driver executes and serializes the same certified in-memory array; artifact SHA and independent checks bind the exported bytes.
scope_limits.scope: This index covers acceptance items 1-4. Actual experiments/costs and repository/GI delivery are evidenced separately under items 5-6.
